review.posthog_relevance: Adds a normalization step to warehouse ingestion, potentially preserving the required 'time' field for downstream billing calculations when RunPod returns billing start dates under a different key.
review.reason: Adds a normalization step and its tests to the RunPod billing record ingestion.
